assets.name: Column 1 Diagram
assets.prompt: A vertical flowchart diagram with a central brain icon connected by blue circular arrows to four surrounding icons: people, bar chart, location pin, checklist. On the left, three stacked icons representing experts. At the bottom, a row of small data type icons. Clean flat design, blue and white color palette.
assets.negative_prompt: 3D, realistic, cluttered, dark background, text heavy

assets.name: Column 2 Diagram
assets.prompt: A vertical schematic diagram divided into three horizontal bands. Top band has a blue shield and five small icons. Middle band has a green shield and five green icons. Bottom band has a purple shield and five purple icons. Below is a blue button and a robot head icon. Grid layout, flat design, security theme.

assets.name: Column 3 Diagram
assets.prompt: A workflow diagram featuring a top row of four icons (book, gauge, network, document). Below, a central 'RAG' circle connected to a wrench icon and a magnifying glass icon. At the bottom, a large shield with a checkmark next to three rectangular boxes. Blue theme, flat design.
assets.negative_prompt: 3D, realistic, cluttered, red colors, text heavy

assets.name: Bottom Left Diagram
assets.prompt: A horizontal process flow diagram enclosed in a rounded rectangle. Features icons for two people, a database cylinder, a human head, a shield with a checkmark, and another database cylinder, connected by blue arrows. Continuous loop style, flat design.
assets.negative_prompt: Vertical layout, 3D, realistic, cluttered, dark background

assets.name: Bottom Right Icons
assets.prompt: Four flat icons arranged horizontally: a target bullseye, a shield with a checkmark, a document with a magnifying glass, and an upward trending bar chart. Blue and grey color scheme, clean vector style.

assets.name: Robot Icon
assets.prompt: A cute, friendly cartoon robot head icon. Blue and white colors, simple geometric shapes, AI assistant style.
